_schema: LEGEND benchmark · input surface spec v1
_note: The allowlist. `benchmark_input_surface.py` copies exactly what is listed here and
nothing else, and `verify` refuses a surface holding anything not listed. Source paths
are relative to --source-root, which is the LEGEND root checkout: the packet lives under
files/, which is git-ignored, so it exists in a checkout and never in a commit.
Adding a path here is a governed change to a tracked artifact, reviewable as such.
Removed on purpose and recorded so the omission is not read as an oversight: the
page renders and figure crops under *_assets/ (S_fig_*, S_page_*, S_native_*, figs/*,
S10_caption_*). They are renders of the source, and their SELECTION encodes a prior
reader's attention — which pages, which panels, at which dpi. Each reader renders what
it needs from the PDF and declares its renders as figure artifacts with digests.
_forbidden_derivation: The 21 tracked paths naming the paper at BASE_HEAD cbce3016, enumerated by:
plus claim_registry_current.md and working_model_current.md — which do NOT name the
paper and are excluded anyway, because they carry what the laboratory already concluded
about it; plus controlled_benchmark_ab.md, which describes this experiment and names
the paper. Governance candidates are excluded from the surface wholesale, so listing
each of them here would be noise.

_note: The paper's identifiers must not appear in anything that is not the paper. The packet
is exempt because it IS the paper; the instructions are exempt because a reader must
be told which PMID it is reading. Everything else scans to zero, or the surface is
not blind. Verified 2026-08-18 on all nine non-instruction text files: 0 hits each.
Structural enumeration of what the paper CONTAINS. Patterns are declared here so the
population is a function of (spec, source) and can be re-derived by anyone. Main
figures and supplementary figures carry their lettered panels, read out of the caption
window that follows the label. Tables, Results subsections and the supplement's
Materials-and-methods sections are units without panels.
notes: PANEL EXTRACTION IS FROM CAPTIONS, and the caption is what the paper printed. Two
observations from the first derivation, recorded so neither is later read as a tool
defect: (1) Supplementary Figure 1 yields A-I, K, L, M — no J. The caption labels (G)
twice and never labels J; the enumeration reports the paper, not a repair of it.
(2) Figure 6 labels its panels [A(i)], [A(ii)], [B(i)]… and the range (C-D). Ranges are
expanded; a single-letter pattern alone reported A,B,E and would have made the
denominator short by two, which flatters both readers' coverage.
The main text carries no numbered Table — main_table is 0 by measurement, not by
This population fixes WHAT the paper contains. It does not rank units by importance:
which of them matter is what the two readings and the adjudication are for.
